description: This file contains implementation of parsing and response formatting functions for a Wi-Fi device management protocol (WDMP). It includes functions for parsing various request types (get, set, attributes, test-and-set, row operations) and for forming response JSON objects with status codes and parameters. Additionally, it provides a utility to map WDMP status codes to human-readable strings. The code includes external JSON handling via cJSON, external protocol-specific headers, and contains several functions that interact with JSON structures to facilitate communication in a device management context.

methods.name: void parse_get_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj,PAYLOAD_TYPE type)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to populate a request structure for a GET operation, handling different payload types and optional attributes.

methods.name: void parse_set_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj,PAYLOAD_TYPE type)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to populate a request structure for a SET operation, extracting parameter names, values, and data types.

methods.name: void parse_set_attr_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request for setting parameters attributes, specifically handling notifications.

methods.name: void parse_test_and_set_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request for a TEST_AND_SET operation, including optional CID and sync parameters.

methods.name: void parse_replace_rows_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a replace rows request, populating table row data.

methods.name: void parse_add_row_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses an add row request, populating a single row of table data.

methods.name: void parse_delete_row_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a delete row request, identifying the specific row to remove.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_get_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Formats a JSON response for a GET request, including parameters, values, and status message.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_get_attr_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Formats a JSON response for a GET attribute request, including parameter attributes such as notification.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_set_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Formats a JSON response after a SET operation, including status messages for each parameter.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_table_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Formats a JSON response for table row operations, with success or failure status.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_test_and_set_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Formats a JSON response for a test-and-set operation, including sync parameters and status.

methods.name: void mapWdmpStatusToStatusMessage(WDMP_STATUS status,char * result)
methods.description: Maps WDMP status codes to human-readable strings for response messages.

methods.name: void getStatusCode(WDMP_RESPONSE_STATUS_CODE * statusCode,int paramCount,WDMP_STATUS * ret)
methods.description: Determines overall response status code based on individual parameter return statuses.

ctags.name: getStatusCode
ctags.pattern: /^ void getStatusCode(WDMP_RESPONSE_STATUS_CODE *statusCode, int paramCount, WDMP_STATUS * ret)$/
